name: Dong Van egg steamed rice rolls
summary: Vietnam Tourism names Dong Van egg steamed rice rolls in the same sentence as Dong Van steamed rice rolls, and lists them as a separate dish. A filling is Check on arrival. The loop page’s steamed egg rolls are not equated with this line. Both names stay.
origin: Đồng Văn, from the English name on Vietnam Tourism’s food page.
where: Đồng Văn. No clock is given.
seoTitle: Dong Van egg steamed rice rolls, a separate dish
seoDescription: Dong Van egg steamed rice rolls are named apart from the steamed rice rolls. A filling is Check on arrival. The loop page’s steamed egg rolls stay a separate name.
